# telnyx_porting_order_activation_job_update (Action)

Changes the activation time of an activation job of a porting order.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activation_job_id` (String) The activation job id.
- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Optional

- `activate_at` (String) The desired activation time. The activation time should be between any of the activation windows.
